usage: Svelte component ports of the best patterns. Scoped styles, zero extra deps.

svelte_components.title: Rubber-stamp CTA (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: Constructivist call to action: type that shouts from a wall beside a rotated double-ring rubber-stamp button that slams straight on hover.

svelte_components.title: Arcade features (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: Neon arcade cabinet in disciplined tokens: a blinking INSERT COIN strip, a double-wide boss card beside three disciplined power-up cards.

svelte_components.title: Hairline footer (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: Swiss-rational grid footer: numbered columns, a single red hairline, and an honest colophon — information architecture as aesthetic.

svelte_components.title: Scandi hero (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: Radical restraint: a full-height vertical hairline with the brand hung like a gallery label, one quiet sentence, vast breathing whitespace.

svelte_components.title: Docs-style pricing (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: Pricing written as documentation: a revision header, an 'on this page' index, numbered plan rows with a marginal chosen-plan note, and honest footnotes.

svelte_components.title: Solo testimonial (Svelte)
svelte_components.description: One huge candlelit quote with a blackletter drop cap and margin attribution — a library after hours, not a card wall.
